_schema.REALM_NAME: string (required) - realm to log in to
_schema.SECOND_USER: string (required) - display name of user 2, mentioned in comments and checked in TC2
_schema.VIEW_NAME: string (required) - view with the pivot card the comments are added to
_schema.CARD_TYPE: string (required) - CellCardType used to locate cells (PivotCard)
_schema.FILTER_NAME: string (required) - saved scope filter applied before using the cells; the user's global scope can point at a deleted filter
_schema.CELL_VALUE_1: string (required) - exact cell text for comment 1
_schema.CELL_VALUE_2: string (required) - exact cell text for comment 2
